run_train_unconditional_ddpm: run the unconditional DDPM training script with ONNX Runtime on a dataset from HuggingFace hub
run_train_unconditional_local_data: run the unconditional DDPM training script using local image folder data with ONNX Runtime
run_train_unconditional_resume: resume DDPM training from a previous checkpoint using the unconditional image generation script
run_train_unconditional_push_hub: train and push the DDPM UNet model to HuggingFace Hub with ONNX Runtime acceleration
run_train_unconditional_ema: train DDPM with Exponential Moving Average model weights using ONNX Runtime
